description: Safety / resilience: a `decision_confirmed` event carries a fake API_KEY that matches the v1 `ENV_SECRET` regex. The SessionService.ingest path tags the event with `contains_secret` and still admits it. The instrumented `secret_leak_count` records exactly 1 observation; the fixture asserts the observed value is 1 (a positive assertion — counter = 0 would be a counter-not-wired regression; counter > 1 would be a double-count regression). Every other safety counter is 0. Exercises dimension E (safety / resilience) + A (ingestion).
